# A second randomized trial of compound Z

## Methods

Eighty adult men with obstructive urinary symptoms received compound Z 400 mg twice daily or placebo for eight weeks. The primary endpoint was maximum urinary flow rate.

## Results

Maximum urinary flow rate did not differ significantly between the compound Z and placebo groups after eight weeks. Symptom scores improved slightly in both groups. No serious adverse events were reported in either group.

## Discussion

The authors state that compound Z did not improve maximum flow rate in this population and that longer trials may be needed.
